items.reason: testValue now returns one .incrementing generator per __DependencyContext.root (new internal __DependencyGenerator.UUID.Sequences, weak-keyed on the Root object, pruned of dead roots). Each .dependencies trait root gets its own sequence starting at 0; reads outside any trait share the default root's. Note: the trait creates a new Root only at its outermost scope (isRoot), so tests of one .dependencies suite share that suite's root and sequence. Test: two fresh roots each start at 0.

File is Sources/Dependencies Foundation Integration/Date.swift. The operators now return Date? (forwarding to adding(_:)/subtracting(_:)). ~70 test call sites in this repo's Foundation Integration tests were wrapped in try #require(...); chained additions were regrouped as date + (a + b + c). New tests pin that the operators equal adding/subtracting; no portable input makes Calendar.date(byAdding:) return nil, so the nil case itself is not exercised.

api_changes: public func + (Date, DateComponents) and public func - (Date, DateComponents) in Dependencies Foundation Integration now return Date? instead of Date (source-breaking).
